subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker while maintainers land and verify the narrower Tool Search fix, or should the remaining provider/session-state scope be split into a new canonical item?
rationale: The current source-level bug is clear for Tool Search, but the issue also carries older provider-streaming and large-content evidence that is not fully covered by the open PR, so maintainer intent is needed before narrowing or closing the tracker.

options.title: Keep broad canonical tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96115 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96127 for the Tool Search subset, and require live proof before closing the broader report.

options.title: Split remaining provider/session scope
options.body: After the Tool Search subset lands, open or designate a narrower follow-up for custom-provider and large-content long-session argument loss, then close this only with links to both paths.

options.title: Declare Tool Search subset sufficient
options.body: Close this after the Tool Search PR lands, accepting that the older custom-provider evidence is stale unless a reporter provides a fresh current-main repro.

recommendation.title: Keep broad canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96115 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96127 for the Tool Search subset, and require live proof before closing the broader report.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant history points to steipete for the Tool Search runtime and the cross-cutting agent/tool boundary decision.
